verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an importable Postman collection explicitly framed for interactive exploration/testing ('try the API interactively before writing code', 'explore and test the Paddle Billing API interactively'), which supports runnable-example exploration for AI-native/developer users. However, a probe for a directly hosted interactive reference page (Swagger/Redoc-style) on the docs site returned 404s at common paths, suggesting the 'interactive reference' is delegated to external tools (Postman, Scalar, Redocly) rather than a first-party built-in interactive console. Missing for 10: confirmed first-party hosted interactive API console with live runnable examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
